parameters.content:
# 01 — Daily Topic Discovery (Overview)

  **What it does:** Runs daily at 9:00 AM (Asia/Manila). Deterministically finds up to 5 unique Tech/AI Google News stories, upserts them into the `Daily News` sheet, and sends one
  Telegram digest with selection buttons. No AI models used. Callback selection is processed by Workflow 02, not here.

  **Important process:**
  `01. Trigger — Daily 9 AM` → `02. Build — SerpAPI Queries` (4 queries, each with `when:1d`) → `03. Fetch — Google News via SerpAPI` (per query; 3 attempts, 5s wait, partial-failure
  tolerant) → `04. Select — Top 5 Unique News` (normalize titles/URLs, exact dedupe by URL then title, deterministic sort, max 5) → `07. Prepare — Daily News Rows` → `08. Write — Daily
  News` (upsert by `result_id`) → `09. Format — Telegram Digest` → `09b. Route — Telegram Button Count` → `10/10a–10d. Send — Telegram Digest` (1–5 topic variants).

  Zero unique results → `07b. Send — No Results Notice` (skips the sheet write).

  **Output:**
  - Google Sheets `Daily News` — `result_id`, `discovery_date`, `fetched_at`, `rank`, `title`, `source`, `url`, `published_at`, `query` (append-or-update on `result_id`).
  - Telegram — one HTML digest with rank, title, source, publication time, and link, plus one `Select N — {title}` button per topic (callback `select|YYYYMMDD|rank`, ≤64 bytes).
  - No results → "no news" notice, no sheet write. Never adds filler.

  **Error handling:**
  - Partial SerpAPI failure → build from successful queries only.
  - Total SerpAPI failure → "Discovery Unavailable" notice → `05b. Stop — Discovery Failure` → Workflow 04 records the incident (never a fake "no news" message).
  - Sheets/Telegram failures → 3 retries, 5s waits, then stop.
  - Unexpected errors bubble to Workflow 04 (`[ADD YOUR WORKFLOW 04 ID]`).
